messages.subject: NicheMapR v2.0.0 now released
parts:
Hi everyone,

I've released a new version of NicheMapR with a finalised version of the ectotherm/DEB modelling functions and a beta version of the endotherm model. There is also now a website with lots of resources about NicheMapR at http://mrke.github.io/

A paper will come out shortly in Ecography on the ectotherm and DEB models - I'll post something here when it does.

All the best,
Mike
